# Amulet of Health (`magic-items:amulet-of-health`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Rare | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

Your Constitution is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is 19 or higher without it.
